notes: Read the complete target, preceding attacks on abortion and queer and transgender rights, all nine candidates and the review. Standardized the necessity claim about a working-people's party, preserved racist and brutal as source characterizations, enumerated the alleged conduct said to undermine trust, resolved domestic and international scope, and named the attacks whose opposition is judged missing. Restored the source's strongest condemnation of alleged Gaza support.

claims.claim_text: Only a party fighting for working people is characterized as capable of defeating fascism.
The program characterizes Democratic elites as embracing Trump immigration policies that it calls racist.
It alleges Democratic elites support what it calls Israel's genocide in Gaza and condemns that alleged support as most abhorrent.
It characterizes Democratic elites as brutally suppressing student protests.
The alleged embrace of Trump immigration policies, Gaza support and suppression of student protests is said to undermine trust placed in Biden and Democrats.
Without a working-class alternative to the Democratic Party, capitalists, Democrats and the far right are predicted to continue violence and injustice in the United States and abroad.
The program judges the United States to lack strong effective opposition to preceding abortion restrictions and attacks on queer and transgender rights.
